release.name: v0.4 complete owner-approved scope
release.objective: Qualify one frozen integrated candidate against every K1-K8 threshold with required independent, platform, compliance and owner approvals; all gates are currently open.

milestones.title: Executable recovery architecture decision
milestones.outcome: A genuinely different, owner-authorized and independently reviewed recovery model defines semantic state, certified boundaries, bounded suffixes, continuity and decisive positive/negative schedules without changing accepted limits.

milestones.title: Sustainable recovery vertical and lifecycle qualification
milestones.outcome: The reviewed recovery path integrates real authenticated durable roles and exact retries, then passes the K2 fault matrix and 100-transition/>64-configuration K3 qualification on the unchanged limits.

milestones.title: Confidential matching with explicit access model
milestones.outcome: A reviewed confidential publication/query design meets bilingual K5 quality and separate privacy attacks jointly with K1/K7 costs and safe epoch migration.

milestones.title: Bounded observer-private transport
milestones.outcome: A reviewed published mixing design meets K6 activity/source-linking targets separately in busy, sparse and colluding scenarios jointly with K1/K7 budgets.

milestones.title: One coherent service candidate
milestones.outcome: Accepted recovery, matching and transport compose with fair admission, exact user journeys, production boundaries and sustainable resources under one candidate identity.

milestones.title: Independent qualification and release decision
milestones.outcome: The same candidate completes the 14-day independent pilot, supported-platform/supply-chain/compliance evidence and full K1-K8 review for an explicit owner release decision.

features.title: Genuinely different recovery architecture decision
features.notes: DEC-009 accepts RSO5 only as a bounded research prototype with a functional lifecycle and independently reviewed unified matrix. Physical power and sustained evidence remain incomplete; original work thresholds and all production/K1–K8 gates remain open. No SOTA or release claim. FEAT-001 remains blocked for full v0.4 acceptance.

features.title: Sustainable recovery vertical
features.notes: Requires accepted FEAT-001 plus separate owner authorization for implementation and independent protocol review. Integrate actual issuer/wallet/witness/coordinator state, durable barriers, interrupted-intent resume and committed-floor catch-up; no parallel incompatible state machine.

features.title: Lifecycle 100 and fault qualification
features.notes: Requires a complete preflighted independently reviewed new path and explicit campaign authorization. Never rerun the stopped frozen100 body. Independent reviewer accepts K2/K3 evidence; finite local tests do not qualify this feature.

features.title: Confidential matching
features.notes: Choose and independently review an established actively secure computation/access model before integration. Existing real-text reconstruction 86-97% and known-text 100% failures block confidential claims. AI/privacy approval remains pending.

features.title: Observer transport
features.notes: Use a reviewed published mixing design with explicit honest independent middle role and sparse envelope. Existing cooperating-hop 32/32 linkage and unqualified experimental two-hop HPKE block observer-privacy claims. Independent protocol/privacy approval required.

features.title: Fair admission
features.notes: Define eligibility provenance, independent labels, attacker/claim costs and equal-rights groups before measurement. No AI eligibility decisions. Community governance, legal/privacy and independent fairness review are human gates.

features.title: Integrated useful service
features.notes: Compose one publish/search/mailbox/consent/recovery dependency graph with exact user-visible retries/notices and accepted roles; no helper component qualifies K1. Independent integration/security review required.

features.title: Device resource envelope
features.notes: Measure complete process trees, cold/warm model lifecycle, 30-minute sustained/idle windows, physical power and every edge without concurrent workloads. Resource qualification and reference-hardware review remain human acceptance gates.

features.title: Independent 14-day pilot
features.notes: Requires >=5 genuinely independent operators and >=3 networks, approved handling/deployment guidance, frozen candidate and explicit pilot authorization. Independent K8 acceptance includes every wall-clock window and supported OS family.

features.title: Platform SBOM and compliance evidence
features.notes: Human legal/privacy/deployment/retention, security, accessibility, supply-chain/license and release-engineering reviews are required. Packaged LICENSE deletion and mixed notices are unresolved. No inferred legal compliance or package/release approval.

features.title: Integrated K1-K8 release decision
features.notes: Final owner production-release decision is mandatory and currently pending. Requires all prior features, full cases on the same frozen candidate, independent protocol/privacy/security acceptance, K8 pilot and CMP approvals. Product-scope approval is not release approval; all K gates remain open.
